minutes_text:
LA VERNE YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Minutes of the Regular Meeting
  January 23, 2024

1. A meeting of the Youth & Family Action Committee was called to order by Chair Rick
  Crosby at 6:32 p.m.

  Executive Board Members present:

  Executive Board
  Rick Crosby, YFAC Chair, Council Member
  Greg Palatto, BUSD
  Denise Fisher, Resident
  Don Kendrick, Resident

2. Review of Minutes  Minutes for the November 28, 2023, meeting were
  approved.

3. SRO Report  Student Resource Officer (SRO) Eduardo Burgos
  discussed safety precautions being taken by the district
  and the high school surrounding sports events and
  games and during the school day. The high school held a
  lockdown drill and it provided good information to the BHS
  administration, faculty, and staff about continued training
  and preparations that will help in case of an emergency
  situation.

4. BUSD Report  Nikole Burgess from BUSD reported about the return
  from winter break. Students and faculty are back in full
  swing and the semester is starting off strong. They are
  holding some spring events including an Elective Rush
  and are preparing for the pre-registration phase of the
  school year. The state of the district will be held on
  February 8 at 10:15 and the Bonita High School Culinary
  students are catering the event as well as the Chamber
  Singers performing at the event.

5. Fund Transfer  Assistant City Manager JR Ranells reported to the group
  that YFAC funds are now being held with the City of La
  Verne.

6. Program Development  Assistant City Manager JR Ranells provided the group
  with an update on the new grant program. The grant is
  now live and the deadline to apply is March 21, 2024 and
  applications can be found at www.cityoflaverne.org/yfac-
  app. Don Kendrick brought an idea to the group about
  creating an opportunity for digital artists at the district to
  have their art be displayed on the signal control boxes.
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes January 23, 2024, page 2

  Assistant City Manager JR Ranells told the group that
  Public Works Director Meg McWade and City Manager
  Ken Domer are both in support of this project and have
  four signal control boxes that they think could be a good
  fit to use. BUSD representative Nikole Burgess shared
  with the group that she would bring this idea back to the
  district administrators to confirm that they would be
  supportive of this idea.

7. Summer Lunch Budget  Assistant City Manager JR Ranells shared that the Tri-
  City Mental Health Community Well-Being Grant which
  has been a large part of the funding for the summer
  lunch program the past two years is available to YFAC
  again this year. Receiving this grant would bring about
  $7,000 towards the anticipated cost of $18,000 for the
  program. Additionally, YFAC has applied for another
  grant which could potentially fund the program for 3
  years.

8. Public Comment  YFAC Chair Rick Crosby proposed potentially moving
  the YFAC meetings to 5:30 or 6pm. There was overall
  positive reception by the Board and community members
  in attendance so City staff will bring back information
  regarding changing the bylaws to reflect a new time.
  Assistant City Manager JR Ranells noted that during
  February there will be a City Hall ADA compliance
  project that means we are unable to meet in the Council
  Chambers for the February meeting. The location of the
  meeting will be moved to another location.

9. Next Meeting  The next YFAC meeting was scheduled for February
  27, 2024.

10. Adjournment  The meeting was adjourned at 7:28 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

Erin Beilstein
Management Analyst
